# human-synapse-bouton-lab

> Full-stack, formally verified human synaptic bouton biophysical workbench (Lean 4.35.0, Rust, TypeScript, Python 50-digit oracle), pre-registered 30-seed Monte Carlo nanocolumn simulator, interactive 9-tab WebGL workbench, and two AMS-LaTeX white papers mapping 11 disciplines of open hard problems toward the consciousness frontier.

## Agent & Governance Entry Points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions, commands, hard rules (R1–R8), six finding classes, and known traps
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, verified Lean fidelity table, Monte Carlo summary, quickstart, and usage examples
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Numbered claims ledger with commands, tests, and refutation criteria
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Honest limits, untested paths, literal-vs-metaphor boundary, and corrections
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-clone replication protocol and recorded replication log
- [PREREGISTRATION.md](PREREGISTRATION.md): Pre-registered Monte Carlo hypotheses committed prior to execution
- [DEVIATIONS.md](DEVIATIONS.md): Transparent log of H3 refutation and exploratory 20 Hz H3b

## Formal Verification & Architecture

- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Isolated 18-theorem Palomar-format challenge specification
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Zero-sorry, zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 proofs
- [lean/NonVacuity.lean](lean/NonVacuity.lean): 19 physiological non-vacuity witnesses
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Multi-language system architecture and Mermaid diagram
- [docs/benchmarks.md](docs/benchmarks.md): Honest Rust vs Node benchmarks and performance budgets
- [docs/reviews/2026-11-23-redteam.md](docs/reviews/2026-11-23-redteam.md): 10-pass adversarial red-team review and six-class findings ledger
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): Frequently asked questions
- [docs/glossary.md](docs/glossary.md): Alphabetized scientific and engineering glossary
